nodes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the gambling game has been started by the owner.
Address of the ETH-X20 Uniswap liquidity pool; rewards are only paid when the sender is this pool.
Incrementing nonce used as part of the randomness seed in _randModulus.
First random seed set once in startGame from the owner-supplied value.
Second random seed derived in startGame from _randModulus.
Chance rate for winning (set to 100 in startGame).
Owner address inherited from Ownable, checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
Owner-only function that initializes seeds, liquidity pool and starts the game.
Overridden ERC20 transfer that recomputes the amount via _getAmount before calling super.transfer.
Overridden ERC20 transferFrom that recomputes the amount via _getAmount before calling super.transferFrom.
View function returning the gameStarted flag.
Private helper that optionally pays a reward and burns a random amount when the game is running.
Private helper that mints a 10x reward when the sender is the liquidity pool and the player wins.
Private helper returning the random amount to burn (between 1% and 10%) for a transfer.
Public, state-changing gambling function comparing two random values, returns true on a win.
Private pseudo-random generator based on nonce, seed, now, block.difficulty and msg.sender.
Internal ERC20 minting function that increases total supply and recipient balance.
Internal ERC20 burning function that decreases sender balance and total supply.
Internal ERC20 transfer implementation called through super.transfer / super.transferFrom.
Internal helper returning msg.sender.
Modifier restricting callers to the owner account by comparing against _owner.
Constructor minting the entire 10000e18 supply to the deployer and leaving the game stopped.
Caller-controlled address used as sender, random seed input and ownership check source.
Miner-influenced timestamp (now) used as randomness input in _randModulus.
_mint(recipient, amount.mul(10)) inside _sendReward creates tokens out of thin air when the random game is won.
_burn(sender, burnAmount) inside _getAmount destroys part of the transferred amount based on randomness.
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(nonce, seed, now, block.difficulty, msg.sender)) pseudo-randomness predictable by miners/callers.
